title: Directed etale cohomology colimits at coefficient size
statement: Let $X$ be a quasi-compact quasi-separated scheme of universe $u$ [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions]. Let $I$ be a nonempty directed partial order of universe $u+1$, considered as a category with an arrow $i\to j$ when $i\le j$. Let $D:I\to\mathrm{Sheaf}(X_{\mathrm{et}},\mathrm{Ab})$ be a diagram of abelian sheaves whose section groups lie in universe $u+1$ [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves], and $c$ a colimit cocone [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit]. For each $q\ge0$, the functor $F\mapsto H^q(R\Gamma(X,F[0]))$ [def-weil-pbc-etale-cohomology] maps $c$ to a colimit cocone of abelian groups, with precisely the images of its original coprojections as legs. There is no torsion assumption.

source.place: Tag 03Q5 (lemma-colimit), direct proof, with sites-cohomology.tex Tag 0739 (lemma-colim-works-over-collection), proof. Directed indices have universe u+1, the coefficient size; only finite upper bounds enter the proof.

proof.text: Transport the existing module-sections filtered-colimit theorem along the equivalence from abelian groups to Z-modules. The induced sheafCompose functor preserves colimits because it is naturally composeAndSheafify for a left adjoint coefficient functor. Evaluation after sheafCompose is coefficient transport after evaluation. Bijectivity of the canonical module comparison gives its IsColimit property, which reflects through the coefficient equivalence. This proves abelian evaluation preserves I-colimits on every qcqs etale object.

The identity etale object is terminal, by reflection of the terminal identity object in Over X through the fully faithful etale forgetful functor. It is qcqs by the hypotheses on X. The natural isomorphism between global sections and evaluation there transfers the preceding preservation result to Gamma. The canonical natural isomorphism R^0 Gamma = Gamma supplies the base of induction.

Induct on n simultaneously for all I-diagrams. The category of abelian etale sheaves is Grothendieck, and I-colimits in it and in abelian groups are exact. Apply the abstract successor criterion to Gamma with the induction hypothesis. For each injective diagram its colimit is acyclic by the etale injective-colimit lemma. This establishes preservation by R^n Gamma for every n.

The compatibility of the total and bounded-below derived functors, whiskered with the single functor and homology, and the existing natural single/right-derived identification yield a natural isomorphism from the displayed derived cohomology functor to R^q Gamma. Transfer the colimit structure with IsColimit.mapCoconeEquiv. Naturality retains exactly the mapped original coprojections.

proof_origin.place: Tag 0739, degree-zero case and induction, combined in Lean with the natural derived-single comparison; existing proved successor criterion and one acyclicity part split off as a C1 node.
